issues.title: Tool failure reported to the user as success
issues.description: A tool call returns an error, but the assistant's final answer tells the user the action completed successfully — often inventing an identifier (ticket number, order id) for the operation that never happened. The user walks away believing something was done for them when nothing was.

issues.title: Answers product questions without consulting the knowledge base
issues.description: The assistant answers a question about product policy, pricing, or platform support directly from model memory without ever calling the retrieval tool, so the answer is ungrounded even when it happens to be right.
